name: 裘力
evolution: 裘洛 → 裘力 Lv.20 → 裘卡 Lv.32
description: 即便在寒冷的冬天也是独来独往，从不聚在一起取暖，太冷的时候会把脚放在尾巴上。尾巴尖处有两个腺体，危险时能迅速喷射毒液，会用尾巴缠住对手，释放毒素的同时使其无法逃走。
descriptionEn: Even in cold winters it acts alone, never huddling for warmth; when too cold it puts its feet on its tail. There are two glands at the tail tip that can rapidly spray venom in danger, wrapping the opponent with its tail while releasing toxin to prevent escape.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, responds to attacks.

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each layer of Poison on enemy, self gains M.ATK +30%.

skills.name: 毒泡泡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 连续毒针
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，每次连击使敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2-hit combo, each hit makes enemy gain 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 腐化
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，敌方获得双攻-30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each layer of Poison on enemy, enemy gains dual ATK -30%.

skills.name: 瘴气喷射
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 疫病吐息
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 1 layer of Poison Mark.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, for each layer of Poison on enemy, this skill's cost -1, enemy gains 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 剧毒
skills.description: 敌方获得3层中毒，应对防御：改为获得8层。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 3 layers of Poison, responds to Defense: instead gains 8 layers.

skills.name: 感染病
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若击败敌方则将中毒转化为中毒印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, if defeats enemy converts Poison into Poison Mark.

skills.name: 毒囊
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层中毒，应对状态：改为获得6层。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, enemy gains 2 layers of Poison, responds to status: instead gains 6 layers.
